column1: # The *DATA storage section of the 1962 object listing — J 90.05, printer
# pages 8 and 9 (PDF pp. 199-200; images/page-199.png, images/page-200.png).
# Transcribed per the scan-measurement rule and verified against both page
# scans (design note M3-14, docs/design/m3-data.md). The fixture holds the
# printed values, not the print lines: BSS/OCT line selection and column
# geometry stay with M4.
# Rows: octal LOC <tab> kind <tab> value <tab> symbol. Kind `oct` carries the
# twelve-octal-digit initial word value; kind `bss` carries the decimal word
# count of an uninitialized reservation. The symbol column holds the printed
# label, blank on unlabelled lines.
# Area extents, for the reader (the test derives them from the rows):
#   CHECK            00000  16 words  derived from PAYRECORD's offset
#   PAYRECORD        00020  20 words  derived from DEPARTMENT.TOTAL's offset
#   DEPARTMENT.TOTAL 00044  20 words  derived from BONDORDER's offset
#   BONDORDER        00070   6 words  derived from ERROROUT's offset
#   ERROROUT         00076   4 words  attested (BSS 4)
#   WORKING          00102   9 words  attested (BSS 9)
#   INTERNAL.TOTALS  00113   9 words  attested (BSS 9)
#   GRAND.TOTALS     00124   9 words  attested (BSS 9)
#   TABLE            00135  24 words  attested by its own OCT rows (+0 to +23)
# MASTER and DETAIL are located records and print no area (J 02.07.05).
# The listing opens the section with a `*DATA BSS 0` header line; it
# reserves nothing and is not a row here.
